headline: Supreme Engineering Limited: NCLT admits Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Supreme Engineering Limited has been admitted into Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The company notified the NSE of the NCLT order on 1 July 2026.
detail: Supreme Engineering Limited, an industrial equipment manufacturer, has been formally admitted into CIRP following an NCLT order. The admission invokes the moratorium provisions under Section 14 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, freezing all creditor actions and enforcement of securities until a resolution plan is approved or liquidation occurs. An insolvency professional will take control of the company's assets and operations during the resolution period. The company disclosed the order to the NSE via regulatory announcement, as required under listing regulations.
